description: WP3.0c signal-validity probe. Frozen 2026-08-26 before any Phase-3 run. Honest test lives on attacker-labeled engine-undecided rows (fiber spread is EXCLUDED from predictors everywhere: it is the certificate's own verdict input and separates decided rows trivially). GO: AUC >= 0.75 on attacker-labeled undecided rows with permutation p < 0.01, OR downstream |rho(spread, naive-pooling error)| >= 0.30 with p < 0.01.

attacker_labeled_undecided_primary: optional attack records embedded in scaling shard rows
downstream_correlation_rows: engine-decided UNRECOVERABLE rows of the merge + cyclic stratum + discordant family (structure+seed rebuildable)

feature_recompute.population: all merge + cyclic rows lacking stored corrected widths (~4514 rows)
feature_recompute.note: share-pinned LP via battery.frechet_bounds on 2 workers; minutes-scale

metrics.primary: AUC per feature + standardized logistic combo (5-fold stratified CV) for predicting attacker-labeled UNRECOVERABLE among undecided rows
metrics.context_only_circular: same metrics on engine-decided rows, reported but flagged as trivial separation (spread IS the verdict input there); spread itself reported only as context

random_m_graph_matches.note: features on random structures matched on n_vars bucket vs real distributions, KS statistic

pre_registered_gates.NO_GO_consequence: no sheaf-side feature clears chance once trivial separation is excluded -> correspondence track permanently closed at accessible scales; C2 characterization may still stand on WP3.0a
